title: Law of Introduction to the Norms of Brazilian Law
title_native: Lei de Introdução às normas do Direito Brasileiro (Decreto-Lei nº 4.657, de 4 de setembro de 1942)
in_force: Planalto's compiled text, as published on the date below. In-force status was not separately verified; the page's own header notes are kept in the text (for example 'Vide …' and 'Vigência' lines).
text_format: UTF-8 plain text, one source paragraph per line, extracted from Planalto's HTML (Windows-1252, no charset declared; the response's Content-Type header: text/html). Planalto's amendment notes stay inline. Superseded wording that Planalto shows struck through is kept and wrapped as ⟦STRUCK: …⟧.
text_caveat: Not official. Only the text published in the Diário Oficial da União is official; Planalto's footer says so. The text is the compilation as published on 2026-10-21, not a historical vintage.
extractor: parser-based rewrite of the Código Penal deposit's extract.py (same post-processing); not deposited in this repository
notes: The page names the law "Lei de Introdução às normas do Direito Brasileiro", with the note "Redação dada pela Lei nº 12.376, de 2010".
